title: Engagement email thread between the Photographer and Quorvane
stipulated_source: Quorvane business email account; export by the Designated Partner
proposition_supported: Engagement for valuable consideration at Quorvane's instance; exclusive five-year catalogue licence of the selects
proposition_weakened: Quorvane as first owner under s. 17 proviso (b): written agreement that the Photographer keeps copyright; licence limited to selects
reliability_notes: Interested-party export; headers and server logs not yet preserved; no signature beyond typed name

title: Bank transfer record for the shoot fee
proposition_supported: Valuable consideration paid for the shoot day
proposition_weakened: Does not show which frames the fee covered or that the Work was taken at Quorvane's instance
reliability_notes: Not a bank-certified copy; account details must be redacted

title: Extra-frame delivery email attaching the Work
proposition_supported: The Work came from the Photographer and was created at the commissioned shoot; some permission to use it
proposition_weakened: The Work was not a select; 'use it as you like' does not identify rights, duration or territory
reliability_notes: Informal and ambiguous wording; Photographer not yet asked what she meant

title: Metadata observation note on Quorvane's copy of the Work; RAW file not located
stipulated_source: Quorvane catalogue server; note by studio operations associate
proposition_supported: Work probably captured on 2023-02-11 with the same camera as the selects
proposition_weakened: Metadata editable; file re-saved 2024-03-18; RAW file missing
reliability_notes: No hash at receipt in 2023; interested party; no independent examiner

title: Catalogue upload log entry and current catalogue page capture
item_type: System log extract and full-page web capture
proposition_supported: Quorvane published and offered the Work for licensing from 2023-03-20
proposition_weakened: Credit line names Quorvane, not the Photographer; may conflict with E-01; weakens reliance on s. 55(2) presumption
reliability_notes: Self-generated log; system administration records not yet collected

title: Licence documents: licence email, acceptance and invoice
stipulated_source: Quorvane business email account and accounting software
proposition_supported: Licence limited to website and official social media, India, 12 months; print and packaging excluded; Pebblequay's access to the Work
proposition_weakened: Invoice says 'ongoing campaign' and omits the term; Quorvane's own authority to license the Work is uncertain
reliability_notes: Typed signature block only; two documents may be read differently

title: Undated screenshot of a social media post, forwarded by a customer
proposition_supported: At some point a Millrook-branded account posted the Work
proposition_weakened: Post date unknown and may fall inside the licence term; account ownership not proved
reliability_notes: Item date unknown (left blank); third-party capture; no URL or metadata; contains personal data

title: Full-page capture of Pebblequay's website home page banner
item_type: Full-page web capture with capture log
stipulated_source: Quorvane office laptop; https://www.pebblequay.example/ captured 15:12 IST
proposition_supported: Website displayed the Work or a close copy after the 12-month term
proposition_weakened: Does not show continuous use since 2024-08-01, current use, or pixel identity
reliability_notes: Interested-party capture; no archival or independent capture; image file and HTML not saved; hash values not reproduced in repository

title: Retail purchase of a Millrook pouch, with photographs and purchase bill
stipulated_source: Grocery store in South Delhi; purchase by studio operations associate
proposition_supported: Pebblequay sold packaging with a similar photograph in Delhi; packaging is an excluded print use
proposition_weakened: Does not show whether the pouch image is a copy of the Work or a separate photograph; no sales volume
reliability_notes: One unit, one shop; print process alters size and colour

title: Correspondence exchange between Quorvane and Pebblequay
proposition_supported: Pebblequay's positions; Pebblequay's knowledge of the claim from 2025-01-24
proposition_weakened: Pebblequay asserts an 'ongoing' licence, an independent reshoot and a social post within the term

title: Respondent's asserted reshoot material
item_type: Two low-resolution JPEGs and a typed metadata summary
stipulated_source: Attachments to Pebblequay's reply in E-10
proposition_supported: Pebblequay ran some shoot of its own product
proposition_weakened: Not proof of independent creation: prior access via E-06; metadata typed rather than extracted; originals not provided
reliability_notes: Low-resolution copies only; no RAW or camera files

title: The Photographer's message to the Designated Partner
stipulated_source: Messaging application on the Designated Partner's phone
proposition_supported: Photographer supports Quorvane taking action; a RAW file may exist
proposition_weakened: Not a valid assignment on its face (s. 19(1)-(2)); silent on past infringements and the right to sue
reliability_notes: Informal; device not imaged; personal device with unrelated personal data
